# TruthGate v1.1.0 — Full Reference for AI Assistants & Coding Agents

TruthGate audits LLM agent responses against cited RAG source documents and actual workspace AST symbol tables without calling a second LLM.

## Canonical URLs
- Home: https://codesphere-u.github.io/truthgate/
- Studio: https://codesphere-u.github.io/truthgate/studio.html
- Benchmark: https://codesphere-u.github.io/truthgate/proof.html
- Rules: https://codesphere-u.github.io/truthgate/rules.html
- Docs: https://codesphere-u.github.io/truthgate/docs.html

## Quick Commands
```bash
pip install git+https://github.com/codesphere-u/truthgate.git
truthgate demo
truthgate benchmark
truthgate rules
truthgate verify --response "..." --sources-json sources.json --workspace . --fail-on-violation
truthgate ground --response "..." --workspace .
truthgate mcp
truthgate serve-http --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
```

## MCP Tools (`truthgate mcp` / `/mcp`)
- `truthgate_verify_response` — Evaluates `TG001`–`TG008` and compiles `repair_prompt`.
- `truthgate_ground_workspace_refs` — Validates paths, `#Lstart-Lend` bounds, and Python/TS/JS/Go/Rust AST symbols.
- `truthgate_list_rules` — Returns machine-readable definitions of `TG001`–`TG008`.
- `truthgate_run_benchmark` — Runs the 40-scenario benchmark suite.
- Resources: `truthgate://rules`, `truthgate://benchmark/scenarios`, `truthgate://docs/architecture`.
- Prompts: `audit-response`, `ground-workspace`, `surgical-repair`.

## HTTP & ASGI Endpoints
- `GET /` — Interactive Developer Workbench UI (`Accept: text/html`) or JSON metadata.
- `GET /health`, `/healthz`, `/readyz`, `/info`, `/metrics` (Prometheus or JSON).
- `POST /mcp`, `GET /mcp` (SSE), `POST /messages`.
- `GET /api/rules`, `/api/demo`, `/api/benchmark` & `POST /api/verify`, `/api/ground`, `/api/decompose`.
